thread:
maya: Heads-up: vendor sync tomorrow 10am PT to reconcile H200 availability windows + Gaudi firmware ETA. Need clear comms for marketplace handoff. Prep doc: https://redwood.docs/syncs/hw-preflight (please add any asks)

 tom: vendor ask list pls. Need final firmware images, kernel pins, and kernel boot args we should bake. Also we should lock model variants for fallback.

 sanjay: I'll run end-to-end compatibility smoke on staging once images available. Please ping image tags. ETA for smoke: 4h after images.

 elaine: I'll draft announcement windows. If H200 slips >72h we'll move marketplace wave; need to know embargo windows by EOD.

 nvidia-liaison: NVIDIA update: H200 initial fleet target Jun 5-12. There's a minor microcode hold that could add ~48-72h in worst case. We'll bring microcode changelog + test artifacts to the call.

 gaudi-ops: Gaudi update: running cross-validate perf on MI300/Gaudi. Seeing perf variance at seq_len>1024 with current kernel. Will attach perf diffs in doc.

 maya: Actions: 1) @tom + @sanjay validate kernel+image by EOD today; 2) @elaine draft comms + embargo windows; 3) @nvidia-liaison confirm rollback SLA and list failure modes. We'll capture in the preflight checklist.

 tom: Suggest a fallback model variant for constrained memory — a B200 quantized profile (bf16+8bit) we can route to automatically if H200 instances are degraded.

 sanjay: Starting smoke now against h200-staging-2. First error showing: ```ERROR: nvmlInit failed: -13
Trace: plugin/cuda/init.c:45
``` Looks like driver mismatch; will retry with driver 535.54.

 maya: Thanks. If driver swap works, we keep both images in the compatibility matrix. If not, escalate to vendor FW owners in the call.

 elaine: Will prepare an "embargo handoff" slide with two windows (primary + +72h fallback). Draft by 3pm PT, shared in the doc.

 nvidia-liaison: Joining tomorrow with firmware owner @amr_dev to walk microcode and rollback playbook. Link to vendor repo: https://vendor.docs/h200/firmware

 maya: Great. Last ask before the call: drop any test logs + gating criteria into the prep doc and add a single-line 'accept/reject' criteria for the quorum. Ping me if you hit blockers overnight.
